summary: This Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A. contains a private deed for the 10th issue of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures in up to two series for public distribution under automatic registration. AXIA Energia S.A. is the issuer, and Pentágono S.A. Distribuidora de Títulos e Valores Mobiliários acts as fiduciary agent. No price per share, premium, or equity stake is mentioned as this is a debt instrument, not an equity transaction. The filing is a routine debt issuance in Brazil, mapped to a U.S. shelf takedown. There are no special-situation corporate events such as M&A, activism, or restructuring. What to watch: none; this is a standard financing transaction.
